title: Mean of a linear projection
statement: Let $-1\leq \rho\leq 1$, let $n$ be any natural number, and let $t$ be any point of the plane. For a pair of sign vectors sampled by choosing the first uniformly and keeping each coordinate for the second with probability $(1+\rho)/2$, the expected inner product of their normalized sum with $t$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is an arbitrary point of the plane
